findings.title: Missing space before the opening brace of `Allow`
findings.description: `func (l *Limiter) Allow(key string) bool{` has no space before `{`. Run `gofmt`, which writes `bool {`.

findings.title: A key that stops calling is never removed from `hits`
findings.description: `Allow` only replaces the slice of the key it is called with. A key that calls once and never again keeps its entry in `hits` forever, so a limiter keyed by client address grows by one entry for every client it ever saw. Delete the key when `kept` is empty, or sweep old keys on a timer.

findings.title: `TestAllowForgetsOldHits` sets the private `hits` map and clock instead of going through `Allow`
findings.description: The test writes `l.hits` and `l.now` directly instead of reaching that state through `Allow` calls and a clock passed to the constructor. Tests should exercise the public API, so a later change to the internal map does not break the test. Inject the clock through `NewLimiter` and make the first call with `Allow`.

checks: quota/limiter.go:32: removing the `t.After(cutoff)` filter keeps the seeded hit, so `Allow` refuses the call and the test fails

findings.title: No test covers the `max < 1` clamp in `NewLimiter`
findings.description: Both tests build the limiter with a max of 1 or 2. Deleting the clamp on lines 19 to 21 fails no test, and a limiter built with a max of 0 would then refuse every call. Add a test that builds one with 0 and expects the first call to pass.

checks: quota/limiter_test.go:9: `NewLimiter(2, time.Minute)`, and line 19 `NewLimiter(1, time.Minute)`, so no test passes a max below 1

findings.title: No test checks that hits older than the window stop counting
findings.description: `TestAllowStopsAtMax` makes its three calls at once and never moves the clock, so no test reaches a hit older than `Window`. Deleting the `t.After(cutoff)` check on line 32 would keep every old hit and refuse callers forever, and no test would fail. Add a test that advances the clock past the window.

checks: quota/limiter_test.go:8: `TestAllowStopsAtMax` calls `Allow` three times with the real clock

caught: No test checks that hits older than the window stop counting
